w: Sharad Punam festival: See special section.
ph: Performing Shangar arti at 7.30 am, 24 Oct 99

w: At 10:20 am, Swamishri visited Aksharvadi, the site for the new shikharbaddh mandir, and discussed the plans. Thereafter, Swamishri visited the old Swaminarayan Mandir consecrated by Shriji Maharaj and where Gunatitanand Swami had served as the mahant for forty years.

In the evening assembly, children performed a beautiful dance on stage. The members of the Kishore Mandal and Yuvak Mandal performed dramas that depicted the sacrifice of Samat Patel and Rudabhai. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
Swamishri performed pujan of the murti of Hanumanji.
At 7.00 p.m. Pujya Viveksagar Swami narrated the significance of Kali Chaudash. In conclusion, Swamishri blessed the assembly.
In the evening assembly, Kenya’s Environment Minister, Stephen Kalonzo Nusyoka, came to meet Swamishri.

Guests : ? Shri Jayramanji Iyer, Director, Stock Holding Corpn. 1. Any action you do, if it is selfless then it will become sublime. 2. The greatest thing in life is to avoid war. Avoid ashanti at any cost. We must consciously try to bring peace around us and if anyone tries to bring peace around himself the world will be a peaceful place. 3. If you want to have these kinds of thought processes to take place in your mind it is very important you change your food habit and become vegetarian. These three messages are really relevant to the world and if everybody listens to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, I am sure our world will be the best place to live. The devas will come from heaven to live on earth.”

Shri Arun Gujarati, President of Maharashtra National Congress Party, stated, “I have seen half the world, but I have never seen such a mandir in my life. It is a spiritual centre, religious centre, tourist centre – whatever one wishes one will get here. And one will definitely get peace here.”
S wamishri blessed 12 youths who had pilgrimaged 600 km on cycle from Kudiyana. Gandubhai observed a liquid fast for 10 days. A sadhu from Bhuj observed a fast for 100 hours.

In the evening assembly, BAPS children performed a drama, ‘Don’t Forget Your Parents’. Then Ghanshyamcharan Swami addressed parents about instilling values in children. Then kishores enacted a drama ‘A Priceless Boon’. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Yogi Bapa wished and established bal mandals and yuvak mandals so that children and youths be nourished with values, excel in studies and grow up to be very good volunteers, businessmen and officers. But today the educational curriculum is such that students become troublesome and agitative. When values like non-stealing, morality, celibacy and non-addictions are introduced from a very young age, they stay till the end of one’s life. And that is why we have bal sabha, kishore sabha and satsang sabha.”

While Pramukh Swami Maharaj was having his meal, Vasudev Swami, who had come from Surat, spoke about the special features of Surat's diamond industry. After he finished, he said, "All of us too have found a diamond. That diamond is priceless."
Saying this, he asked Swamishri, "Do you know who that diamond is?"
Swamishri immediately said, "Yogiji Maharaj."
Vasudev Swami said, "But we have never seen him!"

Swamishri said, "He is present in the murti, isn't he! And he is in all of you too, isn't he! If you look within you will see him; otherwise, who has seen Shriji Maharaj? But if knowledge comes, he can be seen."
Vairagyapriya Swami said, "Yogibapa used to say that Pramukh Swami is our Kohinoor diamond."
Vasudev Swami said, "What Yogibapa has said, we must certainly accept!"
When the sadhus put forward Yogiji Maharaj's argument, Swamishri remained silent.
Vairagyapriya Swami said, "Please bless us that the trade in the diamond we have found goes as well as possible."

Swamishri said, "It is happening, isn't it! We have held on to the company of Shastriji Maharaj, so keep holding on to it. Yogibapa has brought about great growth in India and abroad. We go about on that basis, so everything goes on."

While Pramukh Swami Maharaj was having his meal, Vasudev Swami, who had come from Surat, spoke about the special features of Surat's diamond industry. After finishing, he said, "All of us have also found a diamond. That diamond is priceless."
Having said this, he asked Swamishri, "Do you know who that diamond is?"
Swamishri immediately said, "Yogiji Maharaj."
Vasudev Swami said, "But where have we ever seen him?"

Swamishri said, "He is present in the murti, isn't he! And he is in all of you too! If you look within, you will see him. Otherwise, where have we seen Shriji Maharaj? But if we have knowledge, we will see him."
Vairagyapriya Swami said, "Yogi Bapa used to say that Pramukh Swami is our Kohinoor diamond."
Vasudev Swami said, "We have to accept what Yogi Bapa said, don't we!"
When the sants presented Yogiji Maharaj's reasoning, Swamishri remained silent.
Vairagyapriya Swami said, "Please bless us that the trade in the diamond we have found goes as well as it possibly can."

Swamishri said, "It is happening, isn't it! We have held on to the company of Shastriji Maharaj, so keep holding on to it. Yogi Bapa brought about great growth in India and abroad. If we move about with that as our support, everything will go well."
In today's evening assembly, Mahant Swami Maharaj watched a skit depicting ego. Giving blessings based on it, he said:

"Maharaj has spoken a great deal about (removing) ego. It is fit to be thrown out completely. This ego spoils everything. Once ego comes, conflict and quarrels are sure to come. There is trouble. There are scuffles. And the more ego goes, the more the benefit.

"When there is ego, glory is not understood. A sense of faultlessness does not come. There is no progress. We may think we have 15 virtues, while this one fault is certainly there too. Because of it we do not move forward.

"Yogibapa says, 'A sense of faultlessness towards everyone is our seva.' Everyone is divine; do not bring any muddle into it. The flaws you see in others will trouble you. If we see others as faultless, our intellect becomes faultless. If we see them as faulty, our intellect becomes faulty. As you see the devotees, so your intellect becomes.

"Really, the paper is worth only two paise, but once the government's stamp is on it, it becomes a currency note; in the same way, Maharaj's stamp has been placed: 'The devotees are not human beings.' If ego moves aside, all the work is done. Muktanand Swami wrote, 'The beloved Mohan is at enmity with ego.' Enmity means it is not something to be tolerated. Maharaj does not like it in the least. Then what is the benefit of keeping it? (Through it) moksha and the ekantik state are spoiled.

"This is something to remember especially. Devotion is measured by how much ego moves aside. God likes it. 'There is no greatness like humility.' We feel there is no smallness like humility. If we keep it, we will be crushed. We need no one else's grace if God's grace is there. Grace lies in this alone. But ego gets in the way.

"(Just as) if poison mixes into dudhpak (sweet milk pudding), everything from top to bottom becomes poison. So, in short, become humble. Keep practising it. The more humility, the more our connection with God. God does not come in any other way. The more humility there is, the more God comes into us."
Mahant Swami Maharaj sat for breakfast in the glass cabin at the back facing the garden. Then he said, "We travelled so much abroad, but we saw birds here!"
What subtle observation!

After the cheshta singing, there was talk about food before Mahant Swami Maharaj. Anandbhushandas Swami asked, "From the beginning you did not eat sweets and such things... So was it that you did not like them, or was it for austerity?"
Swamishri said, "Austerity..."
Adarshyogidas Swami asked, "For years you have eaten only simple food, so do you ever feel that you missed out on eating nice things?"
"No." Swamishri said a clear no.
Shriji Maharaj has said in Vachanamrut Gadhada I 18, "The mind, intellect, chitta and ego, I seize them. Just as a lion seizes a goat, in the same way I seize the inner faculties."
Swamishri's state seems to be just like this, because he does not even have the desire to eat.
